title: @ExceptionHandler at Controller Level
description: Handle exceptions locally within a controller using @ExceptionHandler.

slides.title: Local Exception Handling 🧩

quizData.question: Where does an @ExceptionHandler method belong?

options.text: In a separate class annotated with @ControllerAdvice

quizData.explanation: @ExceptionHandler methods can be placed inside a controller (local) or in a @ControllerAdvice (global).

slides.title: When to Use Local Handlers 🎯
slides.content: Local handlers are useful for exceptions that are specific to a single controller. For global handling, use `@ControllerAdvice` – we'll cover that next.
